'''Matthew Clark Responsible Jedis dont start fights''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Matthew Clark]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-4772">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4772 Responsible Jedis dont start fights], DeckTech (matthew "smileybob1" clark, 28 March 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/4772/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/4772/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018192136/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4772/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Matthew Clark]]
* '''Published:''' 28 March 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Responsible Jedis dont start fights''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor HD Clark DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck revolves around locking down the opponent.  It is most effective in breaking down main characters.

== Original post ==

'''Responsible Jedis dont start fights'''
* '''Author:''' matthew "smileybob1" clark
* '''Published:''' March 28, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This deck revolves around locking down the opponent.  It is most effective in breaking down main characters.

=== Strategy ===

I have played this deck since special edition and even before then a variant on it.  Hunt down just made the combo so much stronger.  If you dont know the combo is Responibility of command and Much Anger in him.  I have found that the most deadly thing about the deck is the use of battle grounds.	In conjunction with Come Here the opponent quickly finds that there is nowhere to drain (or battle with mains).

Anyway i have never posted this deck.  In tournament play it is undefeated for over 6 months and it has taken out good high ranking players.  I tweak it every once in a while.	I was hoping i could get some other opinions.  The only deck that really gives it some trouble is operatives but since the Bounty Hunter starfighters Battle Order has been much more effective. Tell me what you think.  Thankyou
